target.statement: XGBoost classifier achieves 87.5% accuracy in classifying EV acceleration performance (High/Mid/Low) from battery cell configuration and related features on 276 EV models
target.table_ref: Section VII.A / IX.A (reported in text, no table number)
target.dataset: EV specifications dataset (478 models, 276 after listwise deletion), sourced from EV-Database.org

compute.basis: No code or data link is provided; the dataset must be scraped/reconstructed from EV-Database.org (including the rarely-disclosed 'number_of_cells' field), then a small XGBoost model trained on 276 samples, so most time is data reconstruction rather than compute.

blockers: No code repository or data link in the paper
Dataset must be reconstructed from EV-Database.org; 'number_of_cells' is often undisclosed, so exact 276-sample subset is unlikely to be recovered
Exact train/test split and hyperparameters not specified, so 87.5% accuracy may not be exactly reproducible
title: The Impact of Battery Cell Configuration on Electric Vehicle Performance: An XGBoost-Based Classification with SHAP Interpretability
